phase: Step 5.0A — Cross-Book Synthesis Specification Hardening Audit
audit_scope: Evaluation and hardening of Step 5.0 architecture against epistemic drift, false consensus, concept collapse, and causal importation

findings.step_5_0_status: Taxonomy truncated from 15 proposed classes to 10 classes without exhaustive semantic preservation proof.
findings.required_amendment: Restore all 15 distinct relationship classes with formal evidentiary thresholds, epistemic boundaries, and negative implications for each.
findings.rationale: Omitting ANALYTICAL_APPLICATION, CONCEPTUAL_EXTENSION, CONCEPTUAL_LIMITATION, DIFFERENT_DEFINITION, and CAUSALLY_RELATED creates semantic collapse where distinct logical relations are forced into generic parallels.

findings.step_5_0_status: Consensus states lacked formal negative rules, risking false consensus when sources share vocabulary or general topic.
findings.required_amendment: Formalize 6 discrete consensus states with mandatory negative rules: SIMILARITY != AGREEMENT, ABSENCE_OF_DISAGREEMENT != AGREEMENT, SHARED_VOCABULARY != SHARED_CONCEPT, UNRESOLVED != CONTRADICTION.
findings.rationale: Prevents synthesis engines from conflating superficial topical overlap with intellectual agreement.

findings.step_5_0_status: Concept mapping model lacked dual-identifier structure and permitted embedding similarity to influence concept equivalence.
findings.required_amendment: Mandate canonical_concept_id vs book_specific_concept_id separation; prohibit embedding similarity alone from establishing equivalence; add explicit non-equivalence evidence field; test polysemic terms like 'freedom' across NW, PM, and BS.
findings.rationale: Without strict conceptual demarcation, words with radically different meanings across genres (e.g. bourgeois autonomy vs revolutionary liberation) are collapsed into single nodes.

findings.step_5_0_status: Attribution model lacked explicit voice layers (author vs character, narrator vs character, subject vs biographer).
findings.required_amendment: Expand attribution schema to explicitly track speaker voice, text level (primary vs secondary), and modality (explicit source assertion vs BKRS synthetic inference); define fallback for ambiguous attribution.
findings.rationale: Fictional characters and secondary biographers must never be cited as speaking for the author or historical subject.

findings.step_5_0_status: Cross-genre interaction rules were qualitative rather than enforceable programmatic boundary constraints.
findings.required_amendment: Codify 9 explicit cross-genre boundaries with permitted relationship types, prohibited inferences, and concrete benchmark examples.
findings.rationale: Prevents fictional scenes from masquerading as historical evidence, and biographer hypotheses from becoming subject facts.

findings.step_5_0_status: Contradiction criteria did not distinguish scope, timeframe, or analytical level differences, risking false contradiction assignments.
findings.required_amendment: Establish a 10-step sequential Contradiction Gate yielding 7 distinct outcome states (TRUE_CONTRADICTION, DIFFERENT_DEFINITION, DIFFERENT_SCOPE, DIFFERENT_FRAME, PARTIAL_OVERLAP, UNRESOLVED_TENSION, NO_ESTABLISHED_RELATIONSHIP).
findings.rationale: Divergent conclusions arising from different frames (e.g. survival vs sacrifice) are dialectical tensions, not propositional contradictions.

findings.step_5_0_status: Prohibition on causal importation did not distinguish source-internal causality from legitimate source-explicit cross-book intellectual influence.
findings.required_amendment: Define 4 discrete causal tiers (A: Source-Internal, B: Source-Explicit Cross-Book Influence, C: BKRS-Generated Causal Hypothesis, D: Mere Temporal/Thematic Association); mandate [BKRS_CAUSAL_INFERENCE] tag with mandatory competing explanations.
findings.rationale: Historical subjects sometimes explicitly read and were influenced by other thinkers; this must be represented without allowing ungrounded causal importation.

findings.step_5_0_status: Proposed SynthesisUnit schema lacked operational audit flags (source_explicitness, concept_mapping_status, human_review_status, inference_rationale).
findings.required_amendment: Incorporate 8 additional mandatory operational fields into the SynthesisUnit schema to guarantee machine checkability and backward auditability.
findings.rationale: Without operational flags, downstream verification engines cannot programmatically distinguish automated inferences from verified source extractions.

findings.step_5_0_status: Adversarial test cases in Step 5.0 were labeled 'VERIFIED' despite not having been executed against an active synthesis engine.
findings.required_amendment: Reclassify all 10 test cases as 'DESIGNED'; specify alternative admissible classifications, prohibited inferences, and circularity safeguards for each.
findings.rationale: Accuracy in test accounting: a test suite cannot be verified before the engine it tests is implemented.

findings.step_5_0_status: Step 5.0 lacked a dedicated catalog of false-consensus archetypes.
findings.required_amendment: Author a catalog of 12 distinct false-consensus archetypes with explicit detection rules and failure modes.
findings.rationale: Protects against subtle LLM blending tendencies where superficially similar prose is coerced into agreement.

findings.step_5_0_status: The proposed 3-view triad assumed a 'dialectical' framing that might inadequately surface non-dialectical analytical relationships.
findings.required_amendment: Re-align view definitions to ensure full coverage of the 5 canonical perspectives: Landscape, Agreements/Differences, Tensions, Evidence/Attribution, and Cross-Book Relationships.
findings.rationale: Ensures the synthesis reading interface is intellectually comprehensive and renderer-agnostic.

findings.step_5_0_status: Conflict resolution between Book Master and Synthesis Unit was stated in prose but lacked a formal programmatic precedence rule.
findings.required_amendment: Codify the Invariant: Book Master is unconditionally immutable and authoritative; any synthesis unit conflicting with an underlying Book Master is automatically quarantined; orphan synthesis units are strictly prohibited.
findings.rationale: Guarantees that the secondary derivation layer cannot corrupt canonical book data.

conditions_for_step_5_1: No production synthesis engine implementation until Step 5.1 data structures are frozen
No Book Master file may be touched
Adversarial test suite must be authored before synthesis engine execution
